summary: Iter30 validated the Pakta Integritas digital flow end-to-end (backend + frontend + admin permission toggle). Backend pytest 13/13 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_pakta_integritas.py -n 0): (1) POST /api/registration action=submit with pakta_integritas_agreed=false -> 400 detail='Anda wajib menyetujui Pakta Integritas sebelum mengirim pendaftaran.'; (2) submit with pakta but missing prereqs -> 400 with detail object containing both missing_education & missing_documents lists (verified IPK and biaya-pendidikan detection + 6 remaining docs); (3) complete student with all 7 education fields + 9 seeded documents submits -> 200 and registration persists pakta_integritas_agreed=true, pakta_integritas_agreed_at ISO ts, pakta_integritas_version='2026-09', documents_locked_at ISO ts, documents_editing_allowed=false, no _id leaked; (4) after submit, POST /api/documents, DELETE /api/documents/{id}, POST /api/profile/extract-{ktp,kk,ktm,academic-record} all return 403 with detail=DOCUMENTS_LOCKED_MESSAGE BEFORE touching storage (guard is first line); (5) provincial admin PUT /api/admin/participants/{uid}/document-editing-permission allowed=true -> 200 + student POST /documents succeeds; super admin allowed=false -> student POST blocked again 403; (6) student mahasiswa.mdj -> 403 on same endpoint; ad-hoc admin_wilayah account seeded in Mongo -> 403 on same endpoint. Frontend Playwright (desktop 1440x900): temp student test.uipakta.* logged in, clicked menu-daftar (registration-sections rendered because super admin toggled registration_open=true only during test window), clicked registration-tab-pakta -> pakta-incomplete-dialog visible with pakta-missing-education listing all 7 fields (Jenjang, Perguruan Tinggi, Program Studi, NIM, Semester, IPK, Nominal Biaya Pendidikan / Semester) and pakta-missing-documents listing all 9 required docs; pakta-integritas-form NOT visible; close-pakta-incomplete-dialog dismisses cleanly. Demo mahasiswa (already submitted) at pakta tab shows pakta-submitted-state (no dialog); at dokumen tab shows registration-documents-locked-notice; DOC_TYPES contains exactly 9 rows and 'Pakta Integritas' is NOT among them (verified digital pakta replaces the upload). ParticipantsPanel code: canManageDocuments={user?.role !== 'admin_wilayah'} at line 198 -> document-editing-permission-panel and toggle-document-editing-permission only rendered for admin/super_admin. Cleanup verified: all TEST_ / test.* accounts and their profiles/documents/registrations/notifications/user_sessions deleted from Mongo; leftover count = 0. registration_open restored to False and asserted via GET /api/site/content after fixture teardown and after UI test cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: PAKTA_INTEGRITAS_EDUCATION_FIELDS labels in backend (line 986-994) use 'Perguruan tinggi', 'Program studi', 'Nominal biaya pendidikan per semester' etc while frontend PENDIDIKAN labels used by RegistrationSections.jsx read 'Perguruan Tinggi', 'Program Studi', 'Nominal Biaya Pendidikan / Semester'. The two label sets are duplicated across backend/frontend and drift-prone. Not blocking (both cover the same 7 keys and the UI uses frontend labels for its dialog, backend labels are only surfaced on 400 responses), but consider a shared source of truth.

PAKTA_INTEGRITAS_DOCUMENTS constant (server.py:975) is duplicated in RegistrationSections.jsx DOC_TYPES (line 21). Same drift risk if a doc name changes. Consider exposing it via /api/site/content or a dedicated endpoint.

ensure_registration_documents_editable() runs before file.read() in POST /api/documents (line 1341 before line 1345) and before OCR calls in extract-* endpoints -> confirmed no storage/OCR side-effect when locked. Good.
server.py is 5380 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, registration, documents, admin, campus, etc.). Not a correctness bug but hurts maintainability.
